heading: An open invitation.
intro: ERS–WVSU welcomes researchers from across WVSU and beyond when their project offers room for economic insight, empirical improvement, or causal analysis. You do not need to arrive with a complete economics model.
proposal_title: Propose a seminar or research collaboration.
proposal_text: A strong submission starts with your research question, identifies where economics or empirical methods might add value, and explains what kind of collaboration or critique you seek. Details of sensitive research ideas can remain private until roles and expectations are agreed.
contact_text: Select the type of inquiry below. The website prepares a draft to the appropriate ERS–WVSU email address; you review it and press Send in your own email application. You can also email the dedicated contacts listed below directly.
